## What GeniusCFO is

GeniusCFO is a web application (BusinessApplication / accounting software) used on desktop and
phone. It is built for Indian businesses that run their own books and for chartered accountancy
and vCFO firms that run books for client companies. It is not a filing portal and it does not
replace professional judgement: firms review prepared entries and retain final sign-off.

## What GeniusCFO does

- Automates routine bookkeeping and journal entries.
- Prepares GST information, including output GST, input tax credit, net payable, due dates and
  mismatches, and GSTR-3B information.
- Prepares financial statements: Statement of Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement,
  Notes to Accounts and Trial Balance.
- Matches bank transactions against accounting entries (bank reconciliation).
- Answers typed or spoken financial questions from updated accounts ("Ask GeniusCFO").
- Shows sales, profit, cash, receivables, payables, working capital and cash runway on one
  dashboard, with alerts on GST, receivables and runway.

## Pricing

All prices are in Indian rupees and exclude 18% GST. The GST-inclusive total is shown against the
selected plan. Billing is monthly or every three months; the three-month option is billed once for
three months of access and costs 20% less than the monthly rate. Every plan begins with a 7-day
trial with full access. Business and CA/Firm plans both start with a one-time ₹9 payment on Razorpay, after which
the visitor signs up and the 7 days begin. No UPI mandate is set up and nothing is
charged automatically after the trial. The ₹9 charge exists because a free trial attracted fake
sign-ups that used up the AI credits meant for trials. After the trial the customer chooses
a plan and pays via Razorpay; if they do not, the AI stops while books, statements, GST screens and
manual entry keep working and nothing is deleted.

Plans for a business running its own books (one company, one user):

| Plan | Monthly | Every 3 months | Per month on 3-month billing | 3-month total incl. 18% GST |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Light | 999 | 2,398 | 799 | 2,830 |
| Pro | 1,999 | 4,798 | 1,599 | 5,662 |
| Pro Max | 2,999 | 7,198 | 2,399 | 8,494 |

Plans for CA and vCFO firms, priced by client companies and team members included:

| Plan | Scope | Monthly | Every 3 months | Per month on 3-month billing | 3-month total incl. 18% GST |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Team | 3 client companies, 2 extra members | 3,999 | 9,598 | 3,199 | 11,326 |
| Enterprise | 10 client companies, 5 extra members | 6,999 | 16,798 | 5,599 | 19,822 |

Add-ons, charged per month on top of any plan: extra team member 299, extra company profile 599.
For firm plans these are described as additional client company 599 per company per month and
additional team member 299 per member per month.

Managed accounting services for business customers, billed separately and not included in any plan:
Accountant+ 999 per month and CA+ 2,999 per month. These services are for business customers,
not for CA/Firm plan holders.

Every plan carries the full product — books, GST, TDS, ITR, unlimited workflows and the
Intelligence Hub. Plans differ in the AI allowance, the level of support, and how many companies
and members are covered.

The website does not sell plans directly. Business pricing actions lead to the ₹9 trial payment on
Razorpay and then to sign-up; CA/Firm pricing actions lead to the same ₹9 trial. Plans are chosen and paid for inside the product after the trial.

## Questions and answers — GeniusCFO for business owners

### What does GeniusCFO do for a business?

It does your bookkeeping. GeniusCFO books entries from your bills, bank statements or Tally, matches your bank, prepares GST, TDS and income tax, and answers money questions from your own books. Your accountant or CA checks the work and files.

### Do I need to know accounting to use it?

No. You see a simple dashboard and ask questions in everyday English, typed or spoken. Your accountant or CA can check the entries and the documents behind them.

### I use Tally. Do I have to stop?

No. Connect Tally once and GeniusCFO checks it every 15 minutes while Tally is open, so your books here stay in step. It only reads from Tally and never changes anything there. See the Tally Connect guide.

### Does GeniusCFO file my GST returns?

It prepares them. GeniusCFO prepares GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9, GSTR-9C, CMP-08 and ITC-04 from your books and gives you the file for the GST portal. You or your CA file it, then record the ARN in GeniusCFO.

### What about TDS and income tax?

Both are included in every plan. The TDS workspace tracks deductions by section, challans and quarterly returns. The income tax page estimates the year's tax from your books and shows your next advance tax payment. Your accountant files.

### Can my accountant or CA see the same books?

Yes. Give them access and they can check the entries, source documents, reports and tax screens in the same workspace you use.

### Can I use GeniusCFO on my phone?

Yes. It works on phone and desktop, so you can check numbers, read warnings and ask questions wherever you are.

### How is GeniusCFO different from Tally or Zoho with AI added?

It was built for AI from the start. In older apps you type entries and the AI helps around the edges. In GeniusCFO the AI books the entries and you check them. Read the full comparison.

### What does the ₹9 trial include?

Seven days of full access to everything, on your own books: bookkeeping, Tally Connect, GST, TDS, income tax, bank matching, warnings and Ask GeniusCFO. You pay ₹9 once on Razorpay, sign up and start the same day. There is no card, no UPI mandate and nothing is charged automatically afterwards. At the end of the 7 days you choose a plan. If you don't, the AI stops while your books, statements and GST screens keep working, and nothing is deleted.

### Why does the trial cost ₹9?

Because a free trial brought in fake sign-ups, and people who used up the AI credits meant for trials with no plan to use the product. A small payment keeps the trial for real businesses and firms, and keeps the AI allowance for them.

## Questions and answers — GeniusCFO for marketplace and D2C sellers
Source: https://geniuscfo.ai/business/sellers

A seller sells on marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart and Meesho, or direct to consumers, and
downloads a settlement report, a payout statement and a TCS report from each platform every month.
GeniusCFO books every line in those exports. There is no marketplace connector: the exports are
uploaded as files, as are purchase bills and the bank statement.

### Does GeniusCFO connect to Amazon, Flipkart or Meesho?

No. There is no marketplace connector. You upload the settlement, payout and TCS exports you already download, with your bank statement and bills, and GeniusCFO books every line in them. Documents of any kind go in; current books come out.

### Which files do I need each month?

The settlement report, payout statement and TCS report from each marketplace, the returns file if you have one, your purchase bills and your bank statement. CSV, Excel, PDF, scans and photos are all read.

### Does my accountant still file my GST?

Yes. GeniusCFO prepares the GST information from your books: output GST, input tax credit, net payable, return status and mismatches. Your accountant reviews the same books in the same workspace and files the returns. Nothing here replaces your accountant.

### How are returns, reversals and TCS handled?

They are booked from the lines in your exports as entries with debits and credits, each carrying its source line, and matched against the payout that landed in the bank. Your profit figure is read off those books, not off a dashboard tile.

### Why do the marketplace dashboard and the bank never agree?

The dashboard tile shows sales less the fees it knows about. The bank shows what landed after commission, TCS, returns and reversals, on each platform's own cycle. Neither figure is profit. The books, current every day, are where the two meet.

## Questions and answers — GeniusCFO for restaurants, cafes and cloud kitchens
Source: https://geniuscfo.ai/business/restaurants

A restaurant's money arrives in three places on three timelines: cash in the drawer, cards through the
card machine, and delivery platform orders paid out weekly net of commission, GST on the commission,
discount share, ads, order fees, TDS and refunds. The purchase side (vegetables, gas, rent, salaries)
never passes through the POS. GeniusCFO books the POS day-end report, the payout statement, the purchase
bills and the bank statement every day into one set of books, so the month's profit is known this month.
There is no POS or delivery platform connector; the reports are uploaded as files.

### Does GeniusCFO connect to my POS or to the delivery platforms?

No. There is no connector. You upload the POS day-end report and each delivery platform's payout statement as files, with your purchase bills and bank statement, and GeniusCFO books every line in them. Documents of any kind go in; current books come out.

### Which papers do I need each month?

The day-end report from the POS, the partner payout statement from each delivery platform, the card machine's settlement, your purchase bills including the handwritten ones, the gas, rent and salary records, and your bank statement. PDF, Excel, scans and photos are all read.

### Does my accountant still do my GST?

Yes. GeniusCFO prepares the GST information from your books: output GST, input tax credit, net payable, return status and mismatches. Your accountant reviews the same books in the same workspace and files the returns. Nothing here replaces your accountant, and the POS stays.

### How are the delivery platform's deductions handled?

Each line on the payout statement, commission, GST on the commission, discount share, ads, order fees, TDS and refunds, is booked as its own entry with debits and credits, carrying the statement it came from. The net payout is then matched to the credit in your bank.

### Where does the food cost figure come from?

From the purchase bills you upload, cash or not. The vegetable, meat, dairy and packaging bills are booked as purchases from the bills themselves, so the month's cost of materials is a figure from documents, not an estimate from the POS. Your accountant reviews the entries.

## Questions and answers — GeniusCFO for restaurant groups
Source: https://geniuscfo.ai/business/restaurant-groups

A group with more than one outlet runs one company profile per outlet. Each outlet's books are current
every day from its own documents, including the central kitchen's challans, so each outlet answers what
it made this month. There is no consolidated group screen and no outlet column inside one set of books:
the group's accountant consolidates from current books and the CA signs.

### Does GeniusCFO show all my outlets in one set of books?

No. Each outlet has its own company profile with its own books, current every day from its own documents. There is no outlet column inside one set of books and no consolidated group screen. Your accountant consolidates the group from the current books of each profile, and your CA signs.

### Which papers does each outlet need each month?

Its day-end report from the POS, the partner payout statement from each delivery platform, its purchase bills, the central kitchen's challans, its rent and salary records, and its bank statement. PDF, Excel, scans and photos are all read.

### Who consolidates the group?

Your accountant, from books that are current rather than month-old files. Each outlet's entries, source records, reports and GST information are reviewed in the same workspace you use, and your CA keeps sign-off. Nothing here replaces your accountant or your CA.

### How is the central kitchen handled?

The kitchen's challan is a document. It is booked in the receiving outlet's profile as that outlet's purchase, with the challan attached, so the outlet's cost of materials includes what the kitchen sent it. Your accountant reviews the entries.

### What does each outlet cost?

A plan covers one company profile and one user; each further outlet is an extra company profile at ₹599 a month. Prices exclude 18% GST. The full price list, managed services and add-ons are on the pricing page.

## Questions and answers — GeniusCFO for CA and accounting firms

### What accounting work can GeniusCFO do for my clients?

The routine preparation. Journal entries with debits and credits, bank reconciliation, Schedule III statements, and GST, TDS and income tax working, for each client company. Your team reviews it and the firm signs off.

### Can my team review entries before sign-off?

Yes. Every entry keeps its source document, nothing from a Tally import is booked until someone approves it, and the firm keeps professional judgement and final sign-off.

### My clients use Tally. Does that work?

Yes. Connect a client's Tally once and GeniusCFO reads it every 15 minutes while Tally is open. It is read-only and the Trial Balance is compared with Tally once a day. See the Tally Connect guide.

### Which GST returns does GeniusCFO prepare?

GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9, GSTR-9C, CMP-08 and ITC-04, from the client's books, with GSTR-2B matching and IMS. Your team files on the portal and records the ARN.

### Does it handle TDS and income tax?

Yes. The TDS workspace tracks deductions by section, challans and quarterly returns. The income tax page estimates the year's tax and the advance tax instalments. Both are prepared from the books for your team to file.

### Which financial statements can it prepare?

Statement of Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement and Notes to Accounts in Schedule III format, plus the Trial Balance and General Ledger.

### How are CA/Firm plans priced?

Team is ₹3,999 a month for 3 client companies and 2 extra members. Enterprise is ₹6,999 a month for 10 client companies and 5 extra members. Extra client companies are ₹599 a month each and extra members ₹299. Prices exclude 18% GST, and billing every 3 months costs 20% less.

### How does the firm trial work?

The same way as for businesses. Pay ₹9 once on Razorpay, sign up, and use everything for 7 days. Nothing is charged afterwards. At the end you choose a firm plan inside the app.

### What does the ₹9 trial include?

Seven days of full access to everything, on your own books: bookkeeping, Tally Connect, GST, TDS, income tax, bank matching, warnings and Ask GeniusCFO. You pay ₹9 once on Razorpay, sign up and start the same day. There is no card, no UPI mandate and nothing is charged automatically afterwards. At the end of the 7 days you choose a plan. If you don't, the AI stops while your books, statements and GST screens keep working, and nothing is deleted.

### Why does the trial cost ₹9?

Because a free trial brought in fake sign-ups, and people who used up the AI credits meant for trials with no plan to use the product. A small payment keeps the trial for real businesses and firms, and keeps the AI allowance for them.

## Questions and answers — Switch to GeniusCFO (https://geniuscfo.ai/business/switch)

### Do I have to stop using my current software?

No. If you use Tally, connect it and keep working in it: GeniusCFO reads your vouchers every 15 minutes and never changes anything in Tally. If you use something else, keep it running and upload the same bank statement and documents here. Compare the two side by side for 7 days.

### What do I need to bring?

One of three things. A Tally connection, set up in about five minutes on the computer that runs TallyPrime. Or Tally XML exports or a Zoho Books backup, uploaded once. Or your bank statement, invoices, bills and receipts as files: CSV, Excel, PDF, scans and photos are all read.

### Does GeniusCFO change anything in Tally?

No. The program only reads from Tally, and it talks to Tally only on the same computer. Nothing is booked in GeniusCFO until a person approves the import, and each Tally voucher is booked exactly once, so uploading the same files again never doubles an entry.

### I run a restaurant on Petpooja. Do I have to upload sales every day?

No. Connect the Gmail or Zoho inbox that receives your Petpooja sales reports, and every new report is read and booked to your company as it arrives. There is no upload and no manual entry.

### Does my accountant have to change anything?

No. Your accountant reviews the same books in the same workspace you use, with the source document attached to every entry, and still files your returns. Nothing here replaces your accountant.

### What does the ₹9 trial include?

Seven days of full access to everything, bookkeeping, GST, TDS and income tax information, bank matching, alerts and Ask GeniusCFO, on your own books. You pay ₹9 once on Razorpay, sign up, and start the same day. There is no UPI mandate and nothing is charged automatically afterwards.

### What happens after the seven days?

Nothing is charged automatically. You choose a plan inside the product. If you don't, the AI stops while your books, statements and GST screens keep working, and nothing is deleted.

### Why does the trial cost ₹9?

Because a free trial brought in fake sign-ups and people who worked through the AI credits meant for trials without any intention of using the product. A small payment keeps the trial for real businesses and keeps the AI allowance available to them.

### Is my data safe if I decide not to buy a plan?

Yes. Nothing is deleted. The AI stops, and your books, statements and GST screens keep working, so you can still open and read everything you uploaded.

### Can I use GeniusCFO on my phone?

Yes. GeniusCFO works on phone and desktop, so you can check business numbers, alerts and answers wherever you are, and ask questions by voice.

## Questions and answers — Tally Connect guide (https://geniuscfo.ai/tally)

### Does GeniusCFO change anything in Tally?

No. The program only reads from Tally, using a fixed set of export requests. It has no way to write to Tally.

### Is my data safe on the way to GeniusCFO?

The program only makes outgoing connections to GeniusCFO, over encrypted HTTPS. It opens nothing on your network for others to reach. It talks to Tally only on the same computer.

### Can an entry be booked twice?

No. Each Tally voucher carries its own ID, and GeniusCFO keeps exactly one entry for each one. Uploading the same files again, or uploading files for a period the program already brought across, finds the vouchers already in your books and does not book them again.

### Can I use both ways?

Yes, though not at the same moment. The sync waits while an upload is being reviewed, and carries on once it is finished or discarded.

### What if I filed a GST return for a month, and a voucher in it changes in Tally?

GeniusCFO does not change a filed period on its own. It holds the change and lists it for you, with the reason, so you can correct it deliberately.

### Is stock brought across?

Your vouchers and ledgers are. Stock values that Tally works out from its inventory are not, and they are left out of the daily Trial Balance check so they do not show as a difference.

### Does the Tally program work on a Mac?

No. TallyPrime runs on Windows, so the program is for Windows. If your Tally runs elsewhere, upload the XML files instead.

### Does my CA still review the books?

Yes. GeniusCFO prepares the entries; nothing is booked until a person approves the import, and drafts wait for review. Your CA keeps final sign-off.

## Questions and answers — Best AI accounting software in India (https://geniuscfo.ai/best-ai-accounting-software-india)

### What is the best AI accounting software in India?

It depends on who you want doing the entries. If you want the software to do the bookkeeping and your CA to check it, we built GeniusCFO for that. If you want to keep typing entries into Tally with some help, TallyPrime 7.1's document reading or an add-on like Vyapar TaxOne fit better. We make GeniusCFO, so weigh our view accordingly.

### What does AI-native accounting mean?

It means the software was designed for the AI to do the bookkeeping, with a person reviewing. Older software was designed for a person to type entries, and AI has been added around it as a helper.

### What is an AI CFO?

An AI CFO is software that reads your books and tells you what they mean: it forecasts cash, warns you early about cash, tax and late customers, and answers money questions in plain English. GeniusCFO works as an AI CFO on top of books it keeps current every day.

### Which accounting software in India has AI CFO features?

GeniusCFO has AI CFO features built in: plain-English questions, early warnings, a cash flow forecast and runway, what-if plans and income tax worked out ahead of time. Zoho Books offers Zia insights on its higher plans. Most other tools on this list offer reports.

### Does AI accounting software replace my CA?

No. GeniusCFO prepares the books and the tax working. Your accountant or CA reviews it, keeps professional judgement and files. The work is automated. The judgement stays human.

### Can I keep using Tally with GeniusCFO?

Yes. Tally Connect reads your Tally books every 15 minutes while Tally is open, and never changes anything in Tally. You can also upload Tally XML files once.

### Does Tally have AI now?

Yes. TallyPrime 7.1, released in June 2026, added TallyIra, including a tool that reads business documents and turns them into entries. Tally has also said it plans to rebuild its core for AI.

### Is there free AI accounting software in India?

Some tools have free plans, such as Zoho Books for businesses under ₹25 lakh revenue, and the basic versions of Vyapar, Refrens, hisabkitab and Khatabook. GeniusCFO's trial costs ₹9 for 7 days of full access.

### Which AI accounting software handles GST, TDS and income tax together?

GeniusCFO prepares GST returns, TDS and income tax with advance tax from one set of books. Many other tools cover GST well; check each vendor's page for TDS and income tax.

### How do I switch accounting software in the middle of the year?

Bring your opening balances and the year's entries across, then run both side by side for a few weeks. With GeniusCFO you can connect Tally or upload Tally or Zoho files, and nothing is booked until you approve it.

## Terms used

- GST — Goods and Services Tax, the indirect tax applied in India. GeniusCFO prices exclude 18% GST.
- Input tax credit — GST paid on purchases that can be set against GST collected on sales.
- GSTR-3B — the summary GST return filed by registered taxpayers in India.
- TDS — Tax Deducted at Source. ITR — Income Tax Return.
- Schedule III — the Companies Act, 2013 format for financial statements.
- CA firm — a chartered accountancy practice. vCFO — virtual or fractional CFO practice.
- Razorpay — the Indian payment gateway used to collect plan payments.

## Blog

Index: https://geniuscfo.ai/blog

### The AI Was Looking at Your Ledger Through a Screenshot.

Canonical article: https://geniuscfo.ai/blog/through-the-glass
Published 11 September 2026. Analysis, not narrative and not a customer result.

The question: what does it cost to have an AI computer-use agent operate accounting software through its
screen, and is that the right place to put the intelligence?

A demonstration put a model in front of TallyPrime and had it record a receipt by voice — reading an overdue
receivables report, then opening a receipt voucher and allocating a payment against a named bill. The
engineering is real and is credited as such. Two objections follow.

The cost. An agent driving a screen runs a loop: capture the screen, reason about the pixels, act, capture
again. Every capture is an image and every image is billed as input tokens. Posting that one receipt takes
about 25 passes. Costed at published list prices — $10 per million input tokens, $50 output, $1 cached, a
Tally screen capture at roughly 1,500 tokens, the last two captures retained in context, and USD/INR at 95.12
on 9 September 2026 — the components are: screen captures and working context 125,000 tokens at $1.25; system
prompt and tool definitions 62,500 cached tokens at $0.06; reasoning and actions 6,250 output tokens at $0.31;
and 2 min 49 sec of realtime voice audio at $0.14. Total 193,750 tokens, $1.76, or 168 rupees for one receipt
on the first attempt. At 98% reliability per step a 25-step task lands first time about 60% of the time, and a
failed run still bills for the steps it completed, which puts the figure nearer 278 rupees per completed
entry. At 400 entries a month that models to 67,000-1,11,000 rupees in model cost alone. Every one of these
numbers is a modelled estimate from published list prices under the stated assumptions, not a measured bill.

The architecture, which is the larger half of the argument. Three problems are structural rather than
commercial, so cheaper tokens do not remove them. First, cost scales with entries rather than with the
business: a better month, with more invoices in it, costs more to record. Second, the agent waits to be asked,
so nothing notices a customer crossing ninety days or a GST mismatch appearing unless somebody thinks of the
question. Third, an agent driving accounting software is procedurally a user with the same reach as anyone
holding the mouse, and it leaves a saved voucher rather than a proposal somebody reviewed before it was
booked.

The alternative put forward is to place the AI underneath the ledger rather than in front of it. GeniusCFO
does not drive accounting software: the accounting engine is the product, with real double-entry and
sub-ledgers, and GST, TDS, TCS, reverse charge and import duty inside the posting itself rather than applied
afterwards. Documents go in — around fifteen Indian document types, including scans and phone photographs —
and booked entries come out, at a fixed monthly price rather than a charge per action. The article concedes
that models and captures will get cheaper and that this arithmetic will look different in two years, while
holding that neither the waiting-to-be-asked problem nor the somebody-else-already-wrote-the-books problem is
a pricing problem.

Computer-use agent, as defined in this article: a language model that operates existing software the way a
person does, by capturing the screen as an image, reasoning about the pixels and sending keystrokes or clicks.
Because every pass through that loop bills a fresh image, its cost scales with the number of entries recorded
rather than with a subscription.

Sources cited on the page: GPT-6 Astra on OpenRouter; CloudZero's GPT-6 pricing breakdown; OpenAI's images and
vision guide; Layer3 Labs' realtime API pricing guide; Contra Collective on computer-use agents in production;
Trading Economics for USD/INR. GeniusCFO plan pricing is as published at https://geniuscfo.ai/pricing and
excludes 18% GST. Third-party products and models are named for comparison and remain the property of their
owners.

The owner and Chartered Accountant retain commercial judgement, review and sign-off. Meera, Coastal House, its suppliers and every financial figure are fictional; this is not a customer result or a promise of savings. ### Nobody Warned You the Business Came With a Second Job.

Canonical story: https://geniuscfo.ai/stories/the-second-job

A fictional garment-unit story about the unpaid finance job an owner inherits as the business grows. A supplier payment, a GST payment and payday fall in the same week while a customer invoice is uncleared. Because the books are kept current every day rather than caught up at month-end, the Intelligence Hub flags a cash gap eighteen days out — 6,40,000 rupees of supplier payment and GST landing before the customer invoice clears — with the posted entries attached to the alert. The alert makes the collision reviewable; it does not make the commercial decision. Professional review and sign-off stay with the Chartered Accountant. Harpreet Singh, the unit, its suppliers and every financial figure are fictional; this is not a customer result or a promise of savings.

The lag, as defined in this story: the time between something happening in a business and the books being able to show it. It does not make the answer wrong; it makes the answer late.

### Your Accountant Is Not Behind. He Is Consolidating Three Companies by Hand.

Canonical story: https://geniuscfo.ai/stories/your-accountant-is-not-behind

A fictional story, written in simple English with a few Hinglish lines, about Vikram, who runs Pepper Lane, a family restaurant with three outlets in Pune and a central kitchen. Each outlet is run as a separate company with its own books. Every month his accountant, Mohan, says the group accounts will be ready by the 15th. One night Vikram watches him work: bills arrive late on WhatsApp, every bill is entered by hand into the right outlet's books, each bank statement is checked, the central kitchen's challans are matched, and only then can the three sets of books be consolidated. To consolidate means to join the books of several companies into one picture of the whole group. The lag is the time between when something happens in your business and when your books show it; with three outlets there are three lags, and the group answer waits for the slowest.

With GeniusCFO they keep one company profile per outlet. Managers upload the POS day-end report, purchase bills, the kitchen challan and the delivery platform's payout statement on the day they arrive; GeniusCFO books each entry with debit and credit in that outlet's books and keeps the source document with it. The accountant reviews and corrects entries. Each outlet can answer for itself through Ask GeniusCFO, with the documents behind the answer. GeniusCFO does not consolidate the three outlets into one group report: the accountant still does that, starting from books that are already current, and the Chartered Accountant checks and signs. Vikram, Mohan, Pepper Lane, its outlets, its suppliers and every figure are fictional; this is not a customer result.
